description: Unit tests for TaskService in the midi namespace, testing task posting, binding, unbinding, static and bound tasks, delayed tasks, and thread safety.

classes.name: TaskServiceClient
classes.description: Helper class to interact with TaskService, posting tasks and managing synchronization events.

classes.name: MidiTaskServiceTest
classes.description: Google Test fixture for testing TaskService functionalities in the midi namespace.

methods.name: GetEvent
methods.description: Returns a static WaitableEvent used for synchronization in tests.

methods.name: SignalEvent
methods.description: Signals the event to unblock waiting tasks.

methods.name: WaitEvent
methods.description: Waits for the event to be signaled.

methods.name: ResetEvent
methods.description: Resets the event to non-signaled state.

methods.name: PostBoundTask
methods.description: Posts a task to a specific runner that increments a counter.

methods.name: PostBoundSignalTask
methods.description: Posts a task that signals an event.

methods.name: PostBoundWaitTask
methods.description: Posts a task that waits on an event.

methods.name: PostBoundDelayedSignalTask
methods.description: Posts a delayed task that signals after a delay.

methods.name: WaitTask
methods.description: Waits for the event to be signaled.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the current count of executed tasks.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including task runner and event reset.

methods.name: RunUntilIdle
methods.description: Runs the task runner until no tasks remain.
